rules.content:
title: Real-Time Payment to New Payee After Credential or Contact Change
status: experimental
description: Detects when a real-time or instant payment (Zelle, FedNow, RTP) is initiated to a previously unseen payee within 24 hours of a credential change (password reset, MFA re-enrollment) or contact informa
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: instant_payments
detection:
    selection_payment:
        event_type: "instant_payment_initiated"
        payment_rail|contains:
            - "ZELLE"
            - "FEDNOW"
            - "RTP"
            - "ACH_SAMEDAY"
        payee_relationship: "new"
    selection_recent_change:
        credential_change_hours_ago|lt: 24
    timeframe: 24h
    condition: selection_payment and selection_recent_change
level: high
rules.title: DL-0055: Real-Time Payment to New Payee After Credential or Contact Change (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Instant Payment Velocity Spike Above 30-Day Baseline")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count() by account_id | compare(op=gt, period=30d, stdev=3)")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring event_type="instant_payment_initiated" (payment_rail="ZELLE" OR payment_rail="FEDNOW" OR payment_rail="RTP" OR payment_rail="ACH_SAMEDAY")
`comment("Aggregation logic from: selection | count() by account_id | compare(op=gt, period=30d, stdev=3)")`
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 1
rules.title: DL-0056: Instant Payment Velocity Spike Above 30-Day Baseline (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Cross-Platform Deposit and Withdrawal Chain")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: (selection_inbound and selection_outbound and filter_amount) | temporal(ordered=true, maxspan=4h, by=account_id)")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
event_type="payment_received"
(inbound_rail="ACH_IN" OR inbound_rail="WIRE_IN" OR inbound_rail="RTP_IN" OR inbound_rail="FEDNOW_IN")
event_type="instant_payment_initiated"
(outbound_rail="ZELLE" OR outbound_rail="FEDNOW" OR outbound_rail="RTP" OR outbound_rail="ACH_SAMEDAY")
outbound_amount_pct_of_inbound>=80
| transaction account_id maxspan=4h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0057: Cross-Platform Deposit and Withdrawal Chain (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Repeated A2A Payments at Maximum Per-Transaction Limit")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and filter_at_limit | count() by account_id > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:a2a_processing
event_type="a2a_payment_initiated"
(payment_rail="ZELLE" OR payment_rail="FEDNOW" OR payment_rail="RTP" OR payment_rail="ACH_SAMEDAY")
amount_pct_of_rail_limit>=95
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 3
rules.title: DL-0058: Repeated A2A Payments at Maximum Per-Transaction Limit (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for New Account Sending Multiple Instant Payments")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and filter_new_account | count() by account_id > 5")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:instant_payments
event_type="instant_payment_initiated"
(payment_rail="ZELLE" OR payment_rail="FEDNOW" OR payment_rail="RTP" OR payment_rail="ACH_SAMEDAY")
account_age_days<30
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 5
rules.title: DL-0059: New Account Sending Multiple Instant Payments (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Zelle Recipient Enumeration via Multiple Failed Lookups")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count() by account_id > 10")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:a2a_processing event_type="zelle_recipient_lookup" lookup_result="not_found"
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 10
rules.title: DL-0060: Zelle Recipient Enumeration via Multiple Failed Lookups (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Real-Time Payment Followed by Immediate Refund or Return Request")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: (selection_payment and selection_refund) | temporal(ordered=true, maxspan=2h, by=payment_reference_id)")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:instant_payments
event_type="instant_payment_completed"
(payment_rail="RTP" OR payment_rail="FEDNOW")
(event_type="refund_request" OR event_type="return_request" OR event_type="rrof_submitted")
| transaction payment_reference_id maxspan=2h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0061: Real-Time Payment Followed by Immediate Refund or Return Request (SPLUNK)
